51	export interface UseTaxonomyResult {
52	  squads: SquadDef[]
53	  squadById: Record<string, SquadDef>
54	  categories: Record<string, TagCategoryDef>
55	  tiers: TierDef[]
56	  tierById: Record<string, TierDef>
57	  /** Convenience array helpers per category. */
58	  tagsIn: (category: string) => string[]
59	  loading: boolean
60	  refetch: () => void
61	}

63	let _cache: TaxonomyData | null = null
64	const _listeners = new Set<(d: TaxonomyData) => void>()
65	let _inflight: Promise<TaxonomyData> | null = null
66	
67	async function fetchAndBroadcast() {
68	  if (_inflight) return _inflight
69	  _inflight = getTaxonomy()
70	    .then(data => {
71	      _cache = data
72	      _listeners.forEach(fn => fn(data))
73	      return data
74	    })
75	    .catch(() => {
76	      const fb = fallback()
77	      _cache = fb
78	      _listeners.forEach(fn => fn(fb))
79	      return fb
80	    })
81	    .finally(() => { _inflight = null })
82	  return _inflight
83	}
84	
85	export function useTaxonomy(): UseTaxonomyResult {
86	  const [data, setData] = useState<TaxonomyData>(() => _cache || fallback())
87	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!_cache)
88	
89	  useEffect(() => {
90	    const onChange = (d: TaxonomyData) => { setData(d); setLoading(false) }
91	    _listeners.add(onChange)
92	    if (!_cache) {
93	      fetchAndBroadcast().finally(() => setLoading(false))
94	    } else {
95	      setLoading(false)
96	    }
97	    return () => { _listeners.delete(onChange) }
98	  }, [])
99	
100	  // Subscribe to SSE so any taxonomy:update across pages auto-refetches
101	  useEffect(() => {
102	    const es = subscribeOrgChart((ev) => {
103	      if (ev.type === 'taxonomy:update') {
104	        fetchAndBroadcast()
105	      }
106	    })
107	    return () => es.close()
108	  }, [])
109	
110	  const refetch = useCallback(() => { fetchAndBroadcast() }, [])
111	
112	  const squadById = Object.fromEntries(data.squads.map(s => [s.id, s]))
113	  const tiers = data.tiers || []
114	  const tierById = Object.fromEntries(tiers.map(t => [t.id, t]))
115	  const tagsIn = useCallback(
116	    (category: string) => Object.keys(data.categories?.[category]?.tags || {}),
117	    [data]
118	  )
119	
120	  return {
121	    squads: data.squads,
122	    squadById,
123	    categories: data.categories,
124	    tiers,
125	    tierById,
126	    tagsIn,
127	    loading,
128	    refetch,
129	  }
130	}

2	 * agentDisplay — single source of truth for how every agent renders across
3	 * Org Chart, Agents page, HR page. Use `formatAgentDisplay(agent)` instead of
4	 * touching `agent.name` or `agent.title` directly. Changing the pattern here
5	 * updates the entire UI at once.
6	 *
7	 * Standard pattern: `RealName — ShortRole` with emoji shown separately.
8	 *   Bold line: `{emoji} {realName} — {role}`
9	 *   Small line below: `{tagline}` (first sentence ≤ 60 chars)
10	 */
11	
12	export interface AgentDisplayInput {
13	  name?: string | null
14	  title?: string | null
15	  description?: string | null
16	  id?: string | null
17	  // Some pages pass org-info nested
18	  org?: { title?: string | null } | null
19	}
20	
21	export interface AgentDisplayResult {
22	  emoji: string
23	  realName: string
24	  role: string
25	  tagline: string
26	  /** `realName — role` (or just `realName` if no role). No emoji. */
27	  fullName: string
28	  /** `emoji realName — role`. Use directly in bold lines. */
29	  fullDisplay: string
30	}

32	const ROLE_WORD_LIMIT = 6
33	const TAGLINE_CHAR_LIMIT = 60
34	
35	/**
36	 * Strip leading emoji from a string. Returns { emoji, rest }.
37	 * Handles compound emoji (skin tone, ZWJ sequences) by greedy match.
38	 */
39	function stripEmoji(input: string): { emoji: string; rest: string } {
40	  if (!input) return { emoji: '', rest: '' }
41	  const m = input.match(/^(\p{Emoji_Presentation}|\p{Extended_Pictographic})[‍️\p{Emoji_Presentation}\p{Extended_Pictographic}]*\s*/u)
42	  if (!m) return { emoji: '', rest: input.trim() }
43	  return { emoji: m[0].trim(), rest: input.slice(m[0].length).trim() }
44	}
45	
46	/**
47	 * Extract real name from `name` string. Drops anything after `—` / `–` / ` - ` / ` (`.
48	 * "Cadence — Chief People Officer"           → "Cadence"
49	 * "🛍️ Shopify App Backend — Backend Engineer" → "Shopify App Backend"
50	 * "tutor"                                    → "Tutor"
51	 * "Mira"                                     → "Mira"
52	 */
53	function extractRealName(rawName: string, fallbackId?: string | null): string {
54	  const { rest } = stripEmoji(rawName || '')
55	  if (!rest) {
56	    return fallbackId ? titleCase(fallbackId) : ''
57	  }
58	  // Split on em/en dash, " - " (with spaces), " | ", or " ("
59	  const beforeSep = rest.split(/\s*[—–]\s*|\s+\|\s+|\s+-\s+|\s*\(/)[0] || rest
60	  const trimmed = beforeSep.trim()
61	  return trimmed || (fallbackId ? titleCase(fallbackId) : rest)
62	}
63	
64	function titleCase(s: string): string {
65	  return s.split(/[-_\s]+/).map(w => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1)).join(' ')
66	}
67	
68	/**
69	 * Clamp a role label to 2-6 short words. Drops trailing parens/clauses.
70	 * "Backend Engineer — Embedded Apps"            → "Backend Engineer"
71	 * "Director of Talent Acquisition Agent Arch.." → "Director of Talent Acquisition"
72	 * "Agent Architect & Hiring Specialist"          → "Agent Architect"
73	 */
74	function shortenRole(rawTitle: string): string {
75	  if (!rawTitle) return ''
76	  // Drop description-like tails (anything after ". " or " for ").
77	  let s = rawTitle.split(/\.\s|—|–|\sfor\s/)[0]?.trim() || rawTitle
78	  s = s.replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)\s*/g, ' ').trim() // drop parentheticals
79	  // Drop everything after "&" or ","
80	  s = s.split(/\s*[&,]\s*/)[0]?.trim() || s
81	  // Word clamp
82	  const words = s.split(/\s+/)
83	  if (words.length > ROLE_WORD_LIMIT) {
84	    s = words.slice(0, ROLE_WORD_LIMIT).join(' ')
85	  }
86	  return s
87	}

89	/**
90	 * First sentence of description, soft-capped to TAGLINE_CHAR_LIMIT chars,
91	 * trailing-punctuation stripped, ellipsis added if truncated.
92	 */
93	function deriveTagline(description: string): string {
94	  const text = (description || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
95	  if (!text) return ''
96	  const m = text.match(/^[^.!?]+[.!?]/)
97	  let s = m ? m[0].trim() : text
98	  if (s.length > TAGLINE_CHAR_LIMIT) {
99	    s = s.slice(0, TAGLINE_CHAR_LIMIT).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '') + '…'
100	  } else if (!m && text.length > TAGLINE_CHAR_LIMIT) {
101	    s = text.slice(0, TAGLINE_CHAR_LIMIT).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '') + '…'
102	  }
103	  return s.replace(/[.!?]+$/, '')
104	}

106	export function formatAgentDisplay(agent: AgentDisplayInput): AgentDisplayResult {
107	  const rawName = (agent.name || '').trim()
108	  const { emoji } = stripEmoji(rawName)
109	  const realName = extractRealName(rawName, agent.id)
110	  const titleSrc = agent.title ?? agent.org?.title ?? ''
111	  const role = shortenRole(titleSrc)
112	  const tagline = deriveTagline(agent.description || '')
113	  const fullName = role ? `${realName} — ${role}` : realName
114	  const fullDisplay = emoji ? `${emoji} ${fullName}` : fullName
115	  return { emoji, realName, role, tagline, fullName, fullDisplay }

## Key Issues (Ranked by Severity)

### 🔴 HIGH
1. **Status enum hardcoded in Hr.tsx:372** — `['active','probation','pip','retired']` should come from API/central enum. If you add a new status (e.g., 'sabbatical'), you must edit this file.

### 🟡 MEDIUM
2. **Tier definitions scattered** — Defined in useTaxonomy.ts (fallback), Governance.tsx, OrgChart.tsx. No single source of truth. Should be one API endpoint.
3. **DEPT_COLORS hardcoded** — If department colors change, must update orgConstants.ts. Consider making this API-driven or CSS-variable-based.
4. **Squad fallback still works for offline** — Good pattern, but if you add/rename squads, both orgConstants.ts AND backend must update.

### 🟢 LOW
5. **Model names hardcoded** — 'sonnet', 'opus', 'haiku' appear in multiple files. Could centralize to constants.ts if models ever change.
6. **UI labels hardcoded** — Tab names, section headers, action labels. Expected in UI code.

---

## Recommendations

1. **Create API endpoint for status values** — Return canonical status enum from `/api/org/statuses` so Hr.tsx doesn't hardcode.
2. **Consolidate tier definitions** — Single `/api/org/tiers` endpoint, use in all three places (useTaxonomy, Governance, OrgChart).
3. **Make department colors dynamic** — Move `DEPT_COLORS` to API response in useTaxonomy or separate endpoint.
4. **Keep squad fallback pattern** — It's working well; just ensure backend + orgConstants.ts stay in sync.
5. **Document orgConstants.ts** — Add comment explaining these are "offline fallbacks" not primary sources.
